_readme: Claude appends an entry here whenever deck data or app behavior changes (newest first). Shown verbose in the settings footer, but ONLY for the JST account. Keep summaries short; details are 1-line bullets.

entries.summary: The About page now leads with the learning problem and demonstrates its claims directly
details: The opening now begins with the weakness of themed vocabulary lists, refers to this app without pretending Fluency is a public product name, and introduces frequency order only as the response
The aunque explanation now says why small linking words matter and makes clear that the app separates their uses and pairs each one with a sentence where it fits

Speech now opens on the discussed aunque card with its real 50/30/20 split, while Lyrics opens directly on fuego at 70/20/10; both demos show percentages for every meaning and no longer cycle through unrelated starter words; cache v125→v126, assets 20260728c→20260728d

entries.summary: Progress storage is simpler, and completed levels can leave the suggestion path
details: Card, sense, Expression, clitic, estimate, and level-routing records now share one typed Progress tab while FlaggedWords remains separate; the first v4 request safely migrates the three old progress tabs to retained *_legacy backups
Each level has a reversible Skip this level in suggestions switch scoped to Speech or the exact artist/language selection; it never fabricates Known cards or changes answer history

Ambiguous verb forms now combine repeated grammar labels, and the finished-set screen blocks background keyboard actions and finds the next unfinished set even across levels; cache v124→v125, assets 20260728b→20260728c

entries.summary: The About page now explains Fluency more clearly and accurately
details: A concise opening now explains that Fluency turns speech and lyrics into frequency-ranked cards with the meaning that fits each sentence
The overlooked but useful word aunque replaces mañana, while the fuego demo shows genuine catalogue lines and an indicative 70% fire, 20% light, 10% passion split
Stale catalogue and source claims were tightened in plain language, and the demo now matches the app's current POS and frequency presentation; cache v123→v124, assets 20260728a→20260728b

entries.summary: Card reports now make notes and classification tags quick and explicit
details: Write a note now opens a focused required text field and cannot submit until something has actually been typed
English, Loanword, and Cognate are promoted to quick classification tags with a clear final action and routing diagnostics included in the audit report
Detailed sense, example, lemma, morphology, frequency, and whole-card reports remain available below; cache v122→v123, assets 20260727q→20260728a

entries.summary: Merged-lemma cards now teach the form used by each example
details: The large Spanish headword follows the current example's exact pooled form while the shared lemma remains visible underneath and continues to own rank, set placement, and progress
Verb morphology and supported English conjugated glosses follow that exact form; English-to-Spanish keeps the unambiguous lemma answer and its existing in-example surface cue
Returning to a merged card advances its example cursor so large families do not always open on the same inflection; cache v121→v122, assets 20260727p→20260727q

entries.summary: The currently selected study set is now unmistakable
details: The active set number has a bright layered ring and a gentle bounce-and-pulse animation while preserving its wrong, review, known, and unseen progress colours
Reduced-motion users get the same strong static selection treatment without animation; cache v120→v121, assets 20260727o→20260727p

entries.summary: Lyrics and Speech setup does less repeated work, with cleaner source and study controls
details: Artist frequency and level setup now share one parsed index, source indexes remain cached by path, and slider/progress/set summaries reuse one prepared filter pass instead of repeatedly cloning the vocabulary
The selected Speech language now uses the same source-card layout as Lyrics, and tapping an already-selected set number starts it without requiring the lower button

Expression and attached-form rows now centre the Spanish form above its English explanation; study options use explicit direction and automatic-speech labels, open Study preferences, return to Main menu, and omit redundant Help
Lyric autoplay is hidden and cannot activate unless at least one bounded Spotify example can actually play; cache v119→v120, assets 20260727n→20260727o

entries.summary: Loading transitions now hide partial screens and sets open without the artificial pause
details: One consistent Fluency loading screen covers authentication, Lyrics/Speech and artist navigation, exact-session resume, review loading, and set-to-set replacement
The login and previous-card layers no longer flash while a destination is still being prepared, and failures safely reveal the underlying app instead of trapping the loader

Decks now render on the next frame rather than waiting 800 ms, while exact resume uses cached progress immediately and reconciles Google Sheets in the background; cache v118→v119, assets 20260727m→20260727n

entries.summary: Proper nouns no longer show up as a card meaning called "proper noun"
details: Gemini recognised names (montana, esperanza, pelé, Snapchat) but, lacking a tag slot, wrote "proper noun" into the translation — those junk meanings were surfacing as main-deck cards

Assembly now drops that label when the word has a real sense (pelé keeps "to peel", iris keeps "rainbow") and routes pure proper nouns to the Extra proper-noun group instead of the main deck — 85 moved
The classify-or-propose prompt now gives Gemini a proper_noun slot and asks it to briefly describe who/what the name is (e.g. "Brazilian footballer") rather than translate it, on the next run

entries.summary: Clitic forms now show their lyrics and grammar, with one clean report menu
details: The report icons now open the modern audit sheet directly instead of routing through the obsolete metadata-and-flag screen
Artist clitic example buckets are attached and preserved across single- and multi-artist decks, so every currently shipped clitic form can reach its real lyric evidence

Attached forms explain infinitive, gerund, or command shape plus the clitic person and role; impossible self-infinitive duplicates such as quité|quité are suppressed when the correct conjugation exists; cache v117→v118, assets 20260727l→20260727m

entries.summary: Plural forms now keep one lemma identity and diminutives explain their base
details: Regular SpanishDict plural twins such as besitos|besitos and besitos|besito consolidate under the singular lemma without changing sense IDs or rerunning Gemini
Diminutives remain independent cards, but a conservative auditable relation layer links examples such as besito to beso
On the next coordinated deck assembly, the card back labels the relation in plain text without merging senses or progress; cache v116→v117, assets 20260727k→20260727l

entries.summary: English-to-Spanish cards now ask for and speak the intended form
details: Unmerged cards answer with the encountered surface form, while Merge Lemmas cards answer with the shared citation lemma
Pronominal verbs safely answer with their complete -se citation and identify exact example forms such as se queja
Expression and attached-form answers now stay aligned across the prompt, revealed answer, active example, and TTS; cache v115→v116, assets 20260727j→20260727k

entries.summary: Merged cards now present the lemma instead of an arbitrary frequent form
details: A merged estar family is headed and spoken as estar even when está remains its internal frequency/rank host
Examples still highlight the exact evidenced form such as está or estemos, while misleading host-form morphology is hidden from the lemma heading
Stable card IDs, progress, levels, ranks, and pooled frequency remain attached to the existing representative entry; cache v114→v115, assets 20260727i→20260727j

entries.summary: Large merged-lemma cards now focus on one item and put detailed knowledge in an overview
details: Merged-lemma cards with more than four learnable items show only the active meaning, Expression, or clitic form instead of filling the card with the complete inventory
The persistent Know/Review strip has moved into a scrollable meanings-and-expressions sheet opened from a bottom card icon with an explicit known/total count
Every item in the sheet can be focused on the card or independently marked Known or Review; cache v113→v114, assets 20260727h→20260727i

entries.summary: Spanish cards now distinguish the encountered form from its dictionary form
details: The card model now keeps display surface, citation form, and future production answer separate instead of making targetWord perform all three jobs
Spanish→English cards show a non-trivial lemma on its own line and explicitly identify forms such as queja → quejarse as a verb with se
Current word/lemma data remains the fallback while optional future pipeline fields are accepted without a schema dependency; cache v112→v113, assets 20260727g→20260727h

entries.summary: Slang and regional meanings Gemini discovered are no longer dropped
details: Off-menu meanings the classifier proposed (guagua=car/van/truck, charro=scrub/jerk/loser, chilla=side chick, manín=my man) were being discarded three times over — at lemma consolidation, at the priority tie-break, and at deck assembly — so cards showed a wrong dictionary sense instead
These proposed meanings now survive consolidation, outrank a stale menu pick on the same line, and get a rendered card even when the dictionary menu never had that lemma
Bad Bunny deck rebuilt: ~600 previously-hidden slang/regional meanings surface across the deck (some words gain a second card alongside a stale one pending the separate lemma-mapping fix)

entries.summary: The level check now estimates a range across the vocabulary
details: The old single-rank staircase is replaced by sampling across ten frequency bands, then concentrating later questions around the uncertain knowledge boundary
Responses are fitted into a frequency-consistent knowledge curve and reported as a receptive-vocabulary range rather than a falsely exact score
Each meaning must be revealed before self-scoring, repeated lemmas are avoided, and artist mode still uses the unbiased Speech frequency list; cache v111→v112, assets 20260727f→20260727g

entries.summary: Spaced repetition can now be paused while the app is developed
details: Study settings now has a persistent Spaced repetition Off/On control, defaulting to Off on devices that have not chosen yet
Off suppresses time-based due cards so they remain Known, while genuine mistakes and partly learned cards still collect in Review
Review stages and timestamps are preserved for later re-enabling; cache v110→v111, assets 20260727e→20260727f

entries.summary: Low-frequency level wording now stays grammatical
details: Levels whose cutoff is one occurrence now say “1 time in the lyrics” rather than “1 times”
Plural lyric and speech frequency descriptions are unchanged; cache v109→v110, assets 20260727d→20260727e

entries.summary: Flagging now produces useful, targeted audit reports
details: Choose a sense–example match, meaning, example line, lemma, word form, whole card, or a free-text-only note as the report target
Problem categories are separate, while reports automatically include stable IDs and relevant assignment, source, timing, morphology, or frequency evidence
The flag dialog is now a modern scrollable sheet with clear previews and a note-only safeguard; cache v108→v109, assets 20260727c→20260727d

entries.summary: Mobile Spotify can activate the open phone app
details: Mobile playback now discovers available Spotify Connect devices, favours the phone, transfers playback when it is inactive, and targets that device explicitly
Stale devices are rediscovered once, while clearer guidance remains when Spotify does not expose any controllable device
Spotify and card-reference icons are larger, more balanced tap targets; cache v107→v108, assets 20260727b→20260727c

entries.summary: Levels, unfinished sets, and Artist Extra now have clearer progression
details: Level summaries drop the duplicate card count and state how many words appear at the selected lyric or speech frequency
An unfinished set produces one Welcome back decision on a later app entry, while reaching the end clears the saved resume point
Artist Extra stays locked until main-vocabulary lyric coverage reaches 60%, with the unlock retained per artist; cache v106→v107, assets 20260727a→20260727b

entries.summary: Study options and settings now share a calmer, persistent design
details: The in-study clock replaces coloured emoji discs with restrained line icons, shorter labels, and a real settings gear in the progress rail
Settings now has Account, Study, Data, and Artists tabs; data freshness and reset tools live together in a scrollable desktop/mobile modal
Card direction and automatic speech persist on this device and are restored by exact set resumes; cache v105→v106, assets 20260726l→20260727a

entries.summary: Due cards now return through level-scoped spaced repetition
details: Correct recalls advance through 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, and 120-day intervals; a mistake resets only the affected card or sense
Due cards join the selected level's Review queue and turn amber, while still counting as Known for vocabulary coverage and never displacing unseen cards from Learn new
Apps Script schema v3 preserves review stages and whole-card timestamps across devices after redeployment; cache v104→v105, assets 20260726k→20260726l

entries.summary: Lyric autoplay now teaches the whole card sense by sense
details: Collapsed meaning rows initially select the overarching sense; clicking a sub-sense still narrows the examples explicitly

Autoplay announces each sense, sub-sense, Expression, or clitic with its English context, plays its eligible lyric clips, and then moves through the rest of the card without repeating the Spanish headword
Skipped Spotify lines no longer shrink the visible example total, and the play/stop control remains reachable on items without a sentence box; cache v103→v104, assets 20260726j→20260726k

entries.summary: Partly learned cards now stay in Review until every item is resolved
details: Knowing one meaning keeps the word in Review and hides that known meaning while presenting its incorrect or untouched siblings
Knowing every sense or Expression promotes the whole card to Known; later item mistakes and later whole-card corrections still override at the right granularity
The level action now says Review cards rather than Review mistakes; cache v102→v103, assets 20260726i→20260726j

entries.summary: Per-sense progress now has stable identity across deck rebuilds
details: Standard and artist decks now retain durable sense IDs, including aliases when equivalent source senses collapse into one visible meaning
Legacy artist senses receive reproducible fallback IDs, while existing content-derived progress remains readable and migrates on the learner's next answer
Verified complete ID coverage for 26,001 standard meanings and 16,995 artist-master senses without a Gemini rerun; cache v101→v102, assets 20260726h→20260726i

entries.summary: Extra vocabulary now fills its categories, with a cleaner setup page
details: Removed the always-visible Main vs Extra description from setup; the confirm popup shown when you tap Extra is now the single explanation
Merge Lemmas and Exclude Cognates are hidden in Extra mode since they don't meaningfully apply there

Extra now keeps English words, loanwords, names, cognates, and interjections instead of dropping them so each groups under its category (Main stays clean); Bad Bunny Extra shows One-off words, English words, Names & places, Loanwords, Cognates and more; cache v99->v100, assets 20260726f->20260726g

entries.summary: Study sets now show known, review, and unseen progress clearly
details: Replaces the single artist/language-coloured seen fill with consistent green Known, amber Review, and neutral Unseen proportions on every set
Removes the unexplained numbered review badge and adds a compact colour key plus exact Known, Review, and Unseen counts for the selected set
Keeps artist and language identity in set borders and the selected-state ring, ready for Review to later mean spaced-repetition cards that are due; cache v98→v99, assets 20260726e→20260726f

entries.summary: Clearer Main vs Extra vocabulary, with Extra grouped by category
details: Artist setup now explains that Main is the core recurring vocabulary to start with and Extra is supplementary — one-off words, loanwords, names, and slang best learned after mostly finishing Main
Choosing Extra opens a short explainer with an explicit Switch to Extra mode confirm, so it can no longer be toggled on by accident

Extra drops frequency levels and instead groups words by category (from the pipeline extra_category field, falling back to one All Extra group when absent), paging each category into study sets; cache v97→v98, assets 20260726d→20260726e

entries.summary: Individual meanings and expressions can now have their own review state
details: The card back can mark the active meaning, Expression, or clitic form as known or needing review and shows how many items on the word are currently known
Whole-card answers remain the default; the newest card or item answer wins, so a later card correct clears older sense mistakes while a later sense mistake reopens only that row
Level review focuses cards onto unresolved rows and granular choices sync offline and across devices after redeploying the updated Apps Script; cache v96→v97, assets 20260726c→20260726d

entries.summary: New cards and level review now follow separate tracks
details: Set progress now measures cards seen, so a wrong answer moves learning forward instead of trapping the learner in the same unfinished set
Each set shows its unresolved-mistake count and the selected level offers one Review mistakes queue that respects the current source, artist scope, Merge Lemmas, and Cognates settings

A newer correct answer resolves an earlier mistake while retaining lifetime counts; Learn new contains only unseen cards and exact saved-set resume remains available; cache v95→v96, assets 20260726b→20260726c

entries.summary: Artist expressions now require the construction they claim to teach
details: Recognises inflected construction families through shared Spanish morphology while requiring a real complement, so voy a casa is not treated as ir a + infinitive
Keeps shorter expressions semantically separate, reuses translations only after independent detection, and leaves untranslated candidates out of learner-facing rows
Rebuilds all three artist decks deterministically without Gemini and retains exact lyric surfaces for highlighting; cache v94→v95, assets 20260726a→20260726b

entries.summary: Artist expressions now pool inflected forms onto exact lyric evidence
details: Counts curated morphological families from the union of distinct lyric lines instead of discarding every form except the most frequent spelling
Carries canonical variants and exact displayed surfaces into Expression rows, so elisions such as vo'a are recognised and highlighted without presenting punctuation-split false matches
Removes broad pronoun-ending fragments, rebuilds all three artist decks deterministically without Gemini, and keeps expressions on word cards; cache v93→v94, assets 20260725al→20260726a

entries.summary: Lyrics now split cleanly into Main and Artist Extra
details: Adds exactly two artist scopes: Main for lemma families evidenced in multiple distinct lyric lines and Extra for genuinely one-off families; one-off surface forms of recurring lemmas stay in Main
Artist Extra keeps every lyric, reuses existing dictionary senses and Speech examples without Gemini, and shows an explicit lyric-only state when no translation exists

Gives each scope its own finishable levels and progress, graduates the final Main level into Extra, and preserves Extra in saved sets, URLs, search, and stats; cache v92→v93, assets 20260725ak→20260725al

entries.summary: Spotify lyric autoplay now groups songs and reuses loaded tracks
details: Builds a one-pass queue grouped by Spotify track so autoplay no longer follows patterns such as song A, song B, song A
Uses local SDK seek and resume for consecutive lines in the same song, transfers the browser device only once, and starts line timing from confirmed playback
Shows a loading pulse for the unavoidable first load of each new song and keeps the autoplay counter sequential; cache v91→v92, assets 20260725aj→20260725ak

entries.summary: In-card navigation now has an explicit no-speech contract
details: Replaces the insufficient card-object identity heuristic with silent-by-default card rendering
Limits headword announcements to explicit deck entry and real card navigation while examples, senses, expressions, autoplay, and display changes cancel queued TTS
Prevents delayed browser utterances from leaking into lyric playback; cache v90→v91, assets 20260725ai→20260725aj

entries.summary: Active-study options now live beside the set progress rail
details: Replaces the rail's separate set-progress info button with the shared radial Study options control on desktop and mobile
Moves Set progress into the radial menu, removes the redundant all-time progress action, and keeps the mobile control above rather than inside the card face
Replaces Direction with the actionable English first or selected-language first label; cache v89→v90, assets 20260725ah→20260725ai

entries.summary: Language setup is now one transforming choice with a reachable source switch
details: Replaces the duplicated Language plus Choose a language rows with one clickable Choose language setup box
Compacts the box to Language with the selected language and source after selection, while retaining the merged progress bar
Lets Speech users reopen the Speech/Lyrics clock and continue into the language-filtered artist picker; cache v88→v89, assets 20260725ag→20260725ah

entries.summary: Autoplay and in-card navigation no longer repeat the headword
details: Limits automatic headword speech to arriving on a different card instead of every updateCard rerender
Makes example, sense, expression, and grouped-row changes silent so lyric autoplay can move without TTS interruptions
Keeps deliberate card-flip answer speech unchanged; cache v87→v88, assets 20260725af→20260725ag

entries.summary: Vocabulary search now opens excluded and examples-only words reliably
details: Keeps search indexed against the complete source vocabulary without mutating it through the active deck filter
Labels excluded results and popup cards with the current reason, including cognate, proper noun, single occurrence, English loanword, and merged lemma form
Builds a deduplicated examples-only card when no usable translation or artist-matched sense exists, and fixes blank result glosses; cache v86→v87, assets 20260725ae→20260725af

entries.summary: The first-login screen now matches the app's modern visual system
details: Replaces the old generic Flashcards dialog with a compact Fluency welcome surface and clearer speech-and-lyrics positioning
Separates Continue with initials and Explore as a guest into clean entry cards, with a calmer inline explanation of the password-free beta
Gives initials entry its own focused state while preserving the existing authentication and storage behavior; cache v85→v86, assets 20260725ad→20260725ae

entries.summary: Lyrics setup now keeps the artist and source easy to change
details: Adds an artist summary card above Lyrics levels with direct actions to reopen the artist clock or return to Speech in the same language
Shortens the duplicated Choose Language heading to Language while retaining the clear Choose a language action
Lightens Young Miko's secondary accent from near-black to lavender for stronger contrast; cache v84→v85, assets 20260725ac→20260725ad

entries.summary: Set completion now always offers the main menu and advances cleanly between levels
details: Keeps Back to main menu as a separate action after every study set, even when another set is available
Uses the primary action for the next unfinished set without wrapping backwards inside the level
Completing the final set offers Level N, Set 1 when another level exists; cache v83→v84, assets 20260725ab→20260725ac

entries.summary: Artist decks rebuilt with song spread, singer credits, and lyric end times
details: Rebuilt Bad Bunny, Rosalía, and Young Miko through deterministic count, merge, inventory, ranking, timestamp, and assembly steps without rerunning Gemini or changing sense layers
Populates every artist inventory entry with its corpus-wide distinct-song count and carries vocalist, Spotify availability, release-variant, and line-end metadata into shipped examples
Preserves the complete existing 45,510 song/sentence example multiset while reordering examples by the new artist, Spotify, and standard-release preferences

entries.summary: Flags can now capture the visible sense–example pairing and a note
details: Makes the selected sense plus currently displayed example the default flag target, with a combined preview and optional 600-character free-text note
Replaces separate wrong-meaning/wrong-example choices with pairing, sense-only, lemma, and whole-card targets and routes the card-info flag action through the same menu
Stores a structured human-readable report in the existing FlaggedWords value column, so no backend sheet or Apps Script deployment is required; cache v82→v83, assets 20260725aa→20260725ab

entries.summary: Desktop lyric autoplay now plays one example line at a time
details: Infers each lyric's end from the next raw LRCLIB timestamp—including empty boundary rows—or the track duration for the final line, and carries it into card data
Adds a desktop play/stop control that plays the current example only, pauses just before its end, advances through the remaining examples once, and skips missing or implausible boundaries
Cancels strict snippets when the tab is hidden and withholds autoplay on mobile where handoff timers cannot guarantee the line boundary; cache v81→v82, assets 20260725z→20260725aa

entries.summary: Lyric examples now credit singers and favour the most useful recordings
details: Carries explicitly named Genius section vocalists to each retained lyric without changing existing example IDs or sense indices, and shows the credit under the lyric
Prioritises examples sung by the active artist, then examples with a Spotify track, then standard releases over remixes/live/alternate versions before the existing teaching signals
Leaves unnamed sections unknown rather than guessing a vocalist; cache v80→v81, assets 20260725y→20260725z

entries.summary: Artist rank ties now use each word's complete song spread
details: Tracks every distinct corpus song containing a word at count time instead of inferring song spread from the capped ten retained examples
Unions song provenance through Spanish/French elision merges and carries the exact count into the ranking inventory
Keeps the old retained-example calculation only as compatibility fallback for inventories built before this schema

entries.summary: Language selection now leads into a Speech or Lyrics choice
details: Removes the separate landing-page mode switch and asks for the learning source only after the language is known
Uses the shared radial clock for Speech and Lyrics; Lyrics opens a second artist clock filtered to artists available in that language, and the setup help now describes the current flow
Keeps direct artist URLs and exact saved-set resume links on their existing fast paths; cache v79→v80, assets 20260725x→20260725y

entries.summary: Progress and set completion now use cleaner, consistent controls
details: Makes dedicated circle-information buttons open landing and active-set progress while the bars themselves are no longer clickable controls
Reworks all-time progress into an explained coverage hero plus compact metric grid and replaces literal question-mark help buttons with accessible information icons
Modernises set completion around one primary continuation action, restrained result metrics, and consistent secondary review/restart buttons; cache v78→v79, assets 20260725w→20260725x

entries.summary: Settings now opens on Account and stores global study defaults
details: Makes the gear open the Account tab instead of overriding the HTML state and jumping straight into Advanced
Adds device-wide Merge Lemmas and Exclude Cognates defaults under Advanced with an explicit persistence warning and immediate current-setup refresh
Applies saved defaults to new Speech and Lyrics setups while exact saved-set resume keeps its original configuration; cache v77→v78, assets 20260725v→20260725w

entries.summary: Started study sets now show their progress directly
details: Gives every 1–99% complete set cell a proportional accent fill so partial work is visible before opening the set
Keeps the current-set focus ring independent from progress and preserves the existing solid completed and dim unavailable states
Uses the same per-set completion percentage already shown in accessible labels and set details; cache v76→v77, assets 20260725u→20260725v

entries.summary: English speech now follows the card's inflected translation
details: Routes every English card utterance through the same conjugation-aware helper used for the visible gloss, so merezco speaks I deserve rather than to deserve
Applies consistently when flipping, swiping between senses, selecting a sense, and selecting a grouped translation
Leaves target-language pronunciation and senses without conjugated-English data unchanged; cache v75→v76, assets 20260725t→20260725u

entries.summary: Spanish verb forms can no longer inherit reverse-dictionary translations
details: Detects legacy SpanishDict direction collisions only when a known conjugation resolves to itself with predominantly Spanish glosses, while preserving legitimate homographs such as vino meaning wine
Repairs sea across Speech, Bad Bunny, Rosalía, and Young Miko as a form of ser with English meaning, morphology, and the existing examples intact
Makes targeted standard menu builds merge-safe and adds one-word artist assignment support so future surgical repairs do not require a full Gemini rerun; cache v74→v75, assets 20260725s→20260725t

entries.summary: Merged-lemma examples now highlight their actual word form
details: Uses the pooledFrom provenance already attached to sibling examples so a querer card can highlight quieres, quiere, or another form actually present in the sentence
Applies a subtly stronger version of the existing word highlight only to pooled sibling forms, leaving ordinary and non-merged cards unchanged
Keeps the canonical card and lemma identity intact while making each example's morphology immediately visible; cache v73→v74, assets 20260725r→20260725s

entries.summary: Front-card morphology is now person-first and fully English
details: Reformats morphology as person and number first, followed by tense and mood, for example 3rd singular · present · subjunctive
Expands compressed 1sg/3pl codes, gives the person phrase stronger emphasis, and prevents unmapped Spanish grammar tokens leaking into the UI
Keeps each grammar label together while allowing multiple possible analyses to wrap as separate tags; cache v72→v73, assets 20260725q→20260725r

entries.summary: Partially completed levels now show their progress
details: Adds a quiet proportional progress marker beneath every partially completed level in the numbered scrubber and fallback level buttons
Uses the same known-card rules as the study-set panel, including artist-specific estimated vocabulary, so level and set completion agree
Keeps automatic selection on the first unfinished level; cache v71→v72, assets 20260725p→20260725q

entries.summary: Card backs now reserve metadata for useful word-form relationships
details: Removes vocabulary rank and corpus occurrence/frequency statistics from the card back while retaining them on the front
Suppresses routine plural lemmas and transparent final-letter elisions on the back, but keeps non-obvious colloquial, clitic, and conjugated surface forms
Handles array-backed morphology variants as real spellings instead of numeric array indexes; cache v70→v71, assets 20260725o→20260725p

entries.summary: Levels now contain stable, rewarding small study sets
details: Assigns a filter-independent frequency position before optional settings, so Cognate exclusions leave holes and merged lemmas stay with their highest-frequency form instead of moving between levels

Divides each level into fixed 20-position sets, automatically selects the first unfinished set, and replaces the old range grid and 25/50 preference with discrete completion cells plus one clear start action
A completed set offers the next unfinished set directly, while exact-session resume retains legacy rank-basis metadata for backwards compatibility
Speech example sorting now recognises punctuation-safe set-word and lemma overlap and gives this nearby-vocabulary signal priority after translation and recent mistakes
Updates setup and help copy for the stable-set model; cache v69→v70, assets 20260725n→20260725o

entries.summary: Frequency levels are shorter, finishable bands with accurate ranks
details: Targets roughly 200 configured cards per level, retaining a ten-level floor for small decks and allowing as many as 80 levels for very large vocabularies
Uses the same adaptive partition and frequency-cliff logic in Lyrics and Speech, deliberately splitting tied low-frequency tiers when no useful nearby cliff exists
Fixes every level claiming to cover Ranks 1–X: the readout and descriptions now show that level's actual start/end ranks and its own card count
Level labels remain Level 1 upward while cumulative coverage, frequency cutoff, and any tie split stay visible; cache v68→v69, assets 20260725m→20260725n

entries.summary: Study setup, navigation, resume, and card metadata are now unified
details: Renames the visible modes to Lyrics and Speech, with subtitle dialogue identified as the source for Speech
Defaults Merge Lemmas to off and Cognates to included, and replaces the old Collapse Lemmas wording throughout setup help
Hides CEFR reversibly while retaining its code path and presents the frequency-aware partitions as Level 1 upward with ranks, card count, coverage, cutoff, and examples
Cards now show rank within the complete vocabulary under the active configuration plus lyric-line or spoken-per-million frequency on both faces
A discrete active-set rail folds previous and next into its ends, while one shared radial hub provides Change set, Shuffle, Direction, Audio, Progress, Settings, and Help
Continue last set restores source, artists, filters, deck order, exact card, sense/example, direction, and card side, with nearest-rank fallback after data changes
Removes the card-within-set counter, moves detailed progress into its modal, and refreshes setup, study, and About help copy
Card-back spacing now uses explicit gaps; expressions and clitics lose their inner capsules, while POS labels use quiet readable chips with colored dots; cache v67→v68, assets 20260724l→20260725m

entries.summary: Artist decks now use corrected counts and refreshed morphology
details: Rebuilt Bad Bunny, Rosalía, and Young Miko so repeated lyric lines count once per song and the expanded conjugation/morphology lookup reaches the shipped decks
Incremental SpanishDict assignment refresh added 13, 67, and 139 covered words respectively; the shared master gains 220 entries and 476 senses versus the previous commit
Final decks contain 10,922 Bad Bunny, 3,218 Rosalía, and 4,463 Young Miko cards; a final build-only pass aligned every index with the stable 15,936-entry master
All 84 changed JSON files and index/master/example relationships validate; cache v66→v67, assets 20260724k→20260724l

entries.summary: Card grammar now reads as one connected colour system
details: Removes Expressions and Clitics from the back legend because their pinned row formats already identify them
Splits the front card's combined POS label into individual colour pills
